name: envpilot-monorepo
description: Envpilot — secure environment variable management for teams
author: Envpilot <hello@envpilot.dev> (https://www.envpilot.dev)

scripts.dev: concurrently --names web,convex,admin --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "turbo dev --filter=@envpilot/web" "convex dev" "turbo dev --filter=@envpilot/admin"
scripts.build:extension: turbo build --filter=envpilot && cd apps/vscode-extension && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies
scripts.setup: cp -n .env.example .env.local 2>/dev/null; ln -sf ../../.env.local apps/web/.env.local && echo 'Environment ready — edit .env.local with your values'
